newsitem.title: FINLAND: YIT WINS FIM 100 MLN NEW ORDERS IN RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: YIT WINS FIM 100 MLN NEW ORDERS IN RUSSIA.

text.p: Finnish construction group YIT-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Thursday it won orders in Russia worth a total of 100 million markka.
YIT said it signed a contract to expand the office and storage facilities of a soft drinks factory in Moscow operated by Coca Cola's local company. The project would be completed by May 1998.

YIT would also erect a laboratory building for the Centre for Technical Diagnostics in the Moscow area. The building would be completed in January next year, it said, adding it was already building a maintenance centre and offices for the same client.

YIT would also supply service stations and other business premises to clients in different parts of Russia. These deliveries would include building elements, interior decoration materials and equipment, it said.
